## Data Types {background-color="white"}

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
A((Data)) --> B(Qualitative - non-numerical)
A --> C(Quantitative - numerical)
B --> D(Nominal)
B --> E(Ordinal)
C --> F(Interval)
C --> G(Ratio)
```

---

| Data Type | Mean | Equidistant | True Zero |
| --- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Nominal | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Ordinal |❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Interval |✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Ratio | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
